states.title: Closed launcher: Panel hidden; one accessible launcher remains. Open, close and Escape preserve the conversation and draft; focus returns safely.
Read-only conversation: Read permission can browse messages and references; no comment or agent submission is available.
Pending local comment: Disconnected comment-capable context explains local pending drafts. Blank text cannot submit; typed comment is human-only.
Connected human comment: Connected comment-only context saves a trimmed human comment without launching an agent and clears it on success.
Failed comment preserves draft: A synthetic comment-save refusal is visible and preserves entered text for retry; no agent launches.
Conversation and references: Human and assistant messages, long wrapped text, known unit history links and unknown/plain references render safely.
Historical revision: Pinned or historical selection keeps its revision on links and blocks write-mode agent requests.
Ask request: Writable agent-capable context selects Ask with discovered model and effort; trimmed request has the exact chosen identity.
Plan request: Writable nonvisual context selects Plan; requires a provider/model and sends a plan request.
Visual Plan request: Visual context uses the saved valid design-option count for Plan; mode controls remain compact and usable.
Change request: Writable authorized context selects Change and submits only with its prerequisites; no real agent/provider is contacted.
No available agent model: Agent-capable context without a usable provider/model cannot submit an agent request; comments remain usable if allowed.
Agent running: Matching synthetic public progress is visible while message entry and duplicate submission are disabled; terminal completion unlocks it.
Saved plan retained: A completed plan retains its public saved-plan response and associated registered-unit references in the conversation.
Agent failure: Synthetic terminal failure is visible in the owning conversation and leaves the composer usable for a deliberate retry.
Agents tracked and empty: Agents tab distinguishes a successful empty roster from unknown tracking and preserves the Chat draft on return.
Active agents and ownership: Agents tab shows current sessions, tasks and module assignments with resolved module history links.
Unknown agent tracking: Unavailable or unsupported activity tracking is explicitly unknown; it does not claim an empty or current roster.
Stale agent tracking: Stale activity data is visibly stale and carries no current module ownership claim.
Long agents roster: A deterministic long roster scrolls within the component while task and module labels remain readable and navigation stays usable.
